mutations.original: subject=str(subject) if subject is not None else None,
mutations.mutated: subject=str(subject) if subject is None else None,
mutations.note: Inverts the None-check so a real subject is dropped to None while a missing one is stored as the literal string "None".
Drops the str() conversion, storing a Path object instead of a string for locator.
Reorders the fallback so once commander_fid is set it can never be refreshed by a later LoadGame event with a different FID.
Wrong-case JSON key means observed_at is always None for real payloads, silently falling back to ingestion time.
Fleet carrier subject extraction reads the wrong nested key.
Drops the "/" boundary check so any endpoint merely sharing a string prefix is misclassified.
Stores the matched endpoint path instead of the full URL as the locator.
Swaps bound parameters against the kind/content_sha256 placeholders, breaking the duplicate lookup that gives archive() its idempotence.
Inverts connection-ownership tracking: a caller-supplied connection is closed under the caller; an internally opened one is never opened.
The local hostname always wins, so the machine parameter is silently ignored.
